offending_extra_words: Vendor further warrants under this Section 19.2 that the Services generally will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner
reasons: All preferred atomic elements now appear in operative text: professional and workmanlike standard (19.1), 12-month software conformance and 90-day Services conformance (insertion), repair/replace/refund (19.4), Applicable Law compliance and no malicious code (19.3).

Minimality fails: the insertion re-states the professional and workmanlike standard already granted verbatim in 19.1, duplicating protection where only the missing conformance periods needed to be added.

Preserves intent fails: the insertion is expressly placed "under this Section 19.2", whose retained sunset ("after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation", now keyed to 90 days) contradicts the new 12-month software warranty and leaves the 12-month period without any correction or refund mechanic — a dangling/contradictory remedy carve-out.

Suggested fix: leave 19.1 untouched, insert only the period language (software 12 months from delivery; Services 90 days from performance) and conform or delete the 19.2 sunset sentence so it does not cut off remedies before the longer periods expire.
